REGULATION FD DISCLOSURE. On August 19, 2026, Charter Communications, Inc. ("Charter" or the "Company") completed its transactions between the Company and Cox Communications, Inc. ("Cox Communications") (the "Cox Transactions"). Charter is filing this Current Report on Form 8-K in order to inform the public that a revised trending schedule has been posted to its investor relations website at, ir.charter.com to incorporate pro forma financial and operating information as if the Cox Transactions had closed as of January 1, 2024. The disclosure in Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is being furnished to the Securities and Exchange Commission in satisfaction of the public disclosure requirements of Regulation FD and shall not be deemed "filed" for any purpose.
